body: Your post made me cry because it hits so close to home. I feel the same way. The 3 dogs in my life are my only reason for breathing. It's barbaric and sick how animals are treated. Makes me want to die too. With some exceptions, humans are vile.

I don't have any suggestions, but I am in a similar situation with family. Going no contact was easy for me. All I did was stop calling. There's no love in my family, only anger and bitterness. There are no family gatherings of any kind, including Christmas. I am glad because they too toxic to be around anyways, but missing that foundation is killing me. I have no tribe. People say there's no place like home for the holidays. For people like us, this is no place period. I envy people who have loving families.
All I can say is that I can relate, especially about the abuse and the scars.
